turns.text: Cross the road at the traffic lights, then turn left.
turns.zh: 在红绿灯那里过马路，然后左转。

turns.text: You'll continue straight for about one block and the museum will be a large white building on your right hand side.
turns.zh: 您继续直走大约一个街区，博物馆就会在您右手边，是一栋很大的白色建筑。

turns.text: It has a glass entrance and a flag outside so it's easy to recognize.
turns.zh: 它有个玻璃入口，外面还有面旗子，所以很好认。
